import mujoco, numpy as np, time

def run_model(timestep=None, iterations=None, ls_iterations=None, solver=None, tolerance=None, ls_tolerance=None):
    model = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path('model_ref.xml')
    if timestep is not None: model.opt.timestep = timestep
    if iterations is not None: model.opt.iterations = iterations
    if ls_iterations is not None: model.opt.ls_iterations = ls_iterations
    if solver is not None: model.opt.solver = solver
    if tolerance is not None: model.opt.tolerance = tolerance
    if ls_tolerance is not None: model.opt.ls_tolerance = ls_tolerance
    
    data = mujoco.MjData(model)
    seed = 42
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    data.qpos += rng.normal(0, 0.01, size=data.qpos.shape)
    mujoco.mj_forward(model, data)
    
    nstep = int(2.0 / model.opt.timestep)
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
